title: Prompt, review against source, check, run
summary: llm~prompt(task) does round 1 (draft from a system prompt describing every provided object and the objects they return, cached with cache_control), round 2 (every ~method the draft sends is looked up on the live objects; its source, read through MethodSourceCache, is sent back with any unknown methods named; the model replies with final code), then ProposalCheck, and one repair round if rejected. The Proposal records a SHA-512 digest of each checked source; ~run refuses if any changed. ~run executes the code as a routine under ADDRESS NEWSHELL_NONE and the security manager as principal llm.
authority: built and tested (architecture Tom Dyer; coding and writing Claude (Opus 5.5), 2026-11-24)
invariants: The model checks the source of the methods it calls against the live objects (Tom Dyer, 2026-11-24)
A changed method source makes ~run refuse
Keys come from the Secret Broker and reach curl on stdin only
procedure: Use the estate Anthropic client (oorexx_ai_provider_anthropic v0.5) for the model call

provenance.claim: Llm: prompt rounds over the estate Anthropic client
